description: I'm a devoted father of two — my kids are the best thing I've ever built. Outside the keyboard I try to stay in motion: long rides on the lakefront, competitive badminton on Tuesday nights, and whatever LEGO set the kids convinced me we absolutely needed. Cooking is how I decompress; there's something satisfying about a recipe that actually works on the first try.
detailOrQuote: The kids are more impressive than anything in my GitHub.

hobbies.name: Cycling
hobbies.detail: Lakefront path, fixed gear, all weather
